tokens.name: surface-000
tokens.usage: Deepest ground: the isometric world's floor, the Level 4 workspace frame, the mini-map well.

tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Page background: ink-wash night in dark, rice paper in light.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Raised panels: Approval Inbox, Alarm Feed, HUD, cards, command palette.

tokens.name: surface-300
tokens.usage: Hover and selected rows, pressed controls, code-block background inside panels. Never a text ground for ink-faint.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on surface-000, surface-100, surface-200 (13:1+ both themes). Also the settled done state.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metadata, timestamps, the blocked state. 5.3:1+ on surface-000 to surface-200 in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Idle state glyphs, disabled text, decorative hairline labels. Meets 3:1 only: never body copy.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and panel edges. Decorative; never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders, input outlines, dormant-station hatching. 3:1+ on surface-100 and surface-200.

tokens.name: panda-ink
tokens.usage: Bao's black fur: ears, eye patches, limbs. Same in both themes; only on mascot art and the brand mark.

tokens.name: panda-fur
tokens.usage: Bao's white fur. Same in both themes; only on mascot art and the brand mark.

tokens.name: qi
tokens.usage: Steam: work moving. Brand accent, the working state, handoff paths, links, the focus ring. Text-safe on surface-000 to surface-200.

tokens.name: qi-fill
tokens.usage: Solid fill for the primary action (Approve) and active segment of a control. Text on it: on-qi.

tokens.name: on-qi
tokens.usage: Text and icons on qi-fill (9:1 dark, 5:1 light).

tokens.name: qi-zone
tokens.usage: Tint behind active handoff paths and the hover halo.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px solid ring, 2px offset, on every focusable element. 5:1+ on every surface.

tokens.name: lantern
tokens.usage: RESERVED: waiting_on_user. Text and icons for approvals, the Needs you badge, stall lanterns, the 80% usage threshold. Never a station color.

tokens.name: lantern-fill
tokens.usage: RESERVED: solid fill for the approval badge, waiting ring and HUD warning bar. Text on it: on-lantern.

tokens.name: on-lantern
tokens.usage: Text and icons on lantern-fill (9.9:1).

tokens.name: alarm
tokens.usage: RESERVED: failed state, alarm text and icons, spill edges, the 95% limit. The only color that shouts. Never a station color.

tokens.name: alarm-fill
tokens.usage: RESERVED: solid fill for alarm badges and the failed-state badge. Text on it: on-alarm.

tokens.name: on-alarm
tokens.usage: Text and icons on alarm-fill (5.4:1 dark, 5.7:1 light).

tokens.name: alarm-zone
tokens.usage: Spill: the warm glow spread across a station floor or under a panda with an active alarm.

tokens.name: state-working
tokens.usage: working: gentle breathing glow plus the ink-brush icon. Always paired with its icon and label.

tokens.name: state-waiting
tokens.usage: waiting_on_user: lantern ring, paper-lantern icon, inbox badge. Always paired with its icon and label.

tokens.name: state-blocked
tokens.usage: blocked: dashed border, shut-door icon, link to the blocker. Always paired with its icon and label.

tokens.name: state-done
tokens.usage: done: seal-chop icon, still, full opacity. Always paired with its icon and label.

tokens.name: state-failed
tokens.usage: failed: alarm border, cracked-bowl icon, alarm-zone glow. Always paired with its icon and label.

tokens.name: state-idle
tokens.usage: idle: dim (opacity-dim), lotus icon, no motion. Always paired with its icon and label.

tokens.name: state-throttled
tokens.usage: throttled: desaturated bun, incense icon, motion slowed to a stop. Always paired with its icon and label.

tokens.name: state-terminated
tokens.usage: terminated: ghosted (opacity-ghost), willow icon, dotted border, history views only. Always paired with its icon and label.

tokens.name: grove-mid

tokens.name: grove-hill
tokens.usage: The leafy mound Bao sits in front of. Scenery only: never text, never a state.

tokens.name: grove-grass
tokens.usage: Grass floor with tufts. Scenery only: never text, never a state.

tokens.name: grove-near

tokens.name: stone
tokens.usage: The Tally stele tablet. Scenery, same in both themes. qi #3aced3 on it is 4.47:1, so marks only; face text goes on stone-deep.

tokens.name: stone-deep
tokens.usage: The stele plinth and the engraved face behind its qi text (5.48:1 with #3aced3). Scenery only: never a state.

tokens.name: ground-shadow
tokens.usage: Soft contact shadow under stones, pads, kiosks and Bao: black at 12%. Scenery, same in both themes. Never text, never a state.

tokens.name: paver
tokens.usage: Stepping-stone fill (stroke is line). Scenery, same in both themes. Never text, never a state.

tokens.name: surface-glass
tokens.usage: surface-200 at 94% for pills, the zoom switcher, the timeline, the Stations card and scene chips over the scene. Text on it uses ink or ink-muted.

tokens.name: cost
tokens.usage: Order budget meter fill. Alias so no biology name reaches code. Text-safe on surface-000 to surface-200.

tokens.name: link-hover
tokens.usage: Link hover, one step off qi. 9.2:1 on surface-200 in light; in dark #7fe3e7 is 10.3:1 on surface-200, brighter than qi.

tokens.name: diff-add
tokens.usage: Added lines in a feed entry (+42). Removed lines use alarm.
